dexes.name: Hyperspace Pokédex
dexes.note: Added by Mega Dimension (version 2.0.0). Numbered 001 to 132; none of these is in the Lumiose Pokédex. Zeraora is not needed for completion. Serebii and PokeAPI (pokedex 35, hyperspace) give the same list and order.

dexes.name: Mega Evolution Pokédex
dexes.note: A section shared by the Lumiose and Hyperspace Pokédexes (Bulbapedia, snippet). An entry is registered when you own the Pokémon and its Mega Stone; seeing it in battle only marks it seen. Tatsugiri’s three Megas share one entry, and so do Magearna’s two. No numbers of its own were found, so "order" is National Dex order (inferred; the in-game order is unsure). "dlc" = added by Mega Dimension. Not in PokeAPI.

home.note: HOME sizes from Bulbapedia (snippet). Only Pokémon from Z-A count; a Mega entry also needs the linked Z-A save to own that Mega Stone. Mythicals count only in the Hyperspace (not Zeraora) and Mega Evolution Pokédexes. Completing all three (without Diancie, Mewtwo, Zeraora and event-only Megas) gives a shiny Volcanion. First deposit from Z-A: Alpha Chikorita, Tepig and Totodile as Mystery Gifts (mobile).

notes: Counts: Lumiose 232 (230 needed), Hyperspace 132 (131 needed), Mega Evolution Pokédex 93 entries (81 needed; 68 and 62 before the DLC); 96 Mega forms (48 from X and Y and Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, 48 new: 26 base game, 22 Mega Dimension); 92 Mega Stones. Alphas: every species except the 25 in notAlpha (inferred from Serebii’s list of Pokémon that can’t be Alpha); "guaranteed" is Serebii’s 100% Alpha spawns in Lumiose (Wild Zone 20 inferred from the page layout); Hyperspace Alphas aren’t listed by place. Megas: "new" = first appeared in Z-A; "dlc" = added to the Mega Evolution Pokédex by Mega Dimension (inferred for old Megas whose species are only in the Hyperspace Pokédex); "eventOnly" = Bulbapedia’s 12 event-only Megas (snippet), not needed for completion. shinyLocked lists encounters (gifts, story); "shinyElsewhereInGame": null means no shiny route in the game. Names follow the app’s GO dex spelling. Sources and anything unsure: research/games/legends-za.md.
